title: Store Update 1.35.0
body:
# Store Update 1.35.0

Raiders!

Two fresh colour options, Blue Frost and Camo, have arrived in the shop for the Bogwalker Set. Anyone who already owns the set will receive both variants automatically, no extra purchase needed.

For raiders closing in on finishing the Expedition requirements but still short on a Sirena Dorata ship model or two, there's good news: Ermal is carrying some in stock this week, with offers going live at 4AM PDT / 1 PM CEST.

Denuvo Anti-Cheat has now been rolled out to the entire player base. The team is watching closely to track its performance and effects, and a broader update on fair play efforts is in the works, to be shared once it's ready.

See you Topside, //Ossen
